description:
# Reference: DPC4-ChampSim/replacement/mockingjay, single-core build. Sizes are for
# the DPC4 LLC, 4096 x 12: INF_RD 95, INF_ETR 11, MAX_RD 73, 11-bit signatures,
# 32 sampled sets. The multi-core build folds the core id instead of the hit bit,
# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay
doc: >
  Mockingjay: each line holds an estimated time to reuse (ETR), counted down every
  8 accesses to its set; the victim is the line with the largest |ETR|, an overdue
  (negative) one on ties. A predictor table keyed by the hit-or-miss PC signature
  gives the ETR on insertion, and a fill predicted to be reused after every line in
  the set is bypassed. A sampled shadow cache on 32 sets measures reuse distances
  with an 8-bit per-set clock and trains the predictor one step at a time; entries
  older than INF_RD train it up as scans. Writebacks are inserted at -INF_ETR and
  train nothing.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

new_words_text:
- name: confident_bypass
  place: condition
  params: {rdp: table, conf: table, index: signature, rdp_thresh: {int: [0, 127]}, conf_thresh: {int: [0, 3]}}
  means: >
    Reads the entry of the rdp table at the index. If it is absent, returns false.
    Otherwise, reads the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent
    entry as 0). Returns true if the rdp entry is greater than rdp_thresh and the
    conf entry is greater than or equal to conf_thresh.

- name: train_ema
  place: step
  params: {table: table, index: signature, sample: state, scale: {int: [1, 4]}, shift: {int: [0, 7]}}
  means: >
    Calculates a target value as the sample multiplied by the scale, clamped to
    the table's maximum. Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is
    absent, sets it to the target value. If present, computes the signed difference
    (target - entry), divides it by 2 to the power of shift (integer division
    rounding towards zero), and adds the result to the entry. The final value is
    clamped to the table's minimum (0) and maximum.

- name: train_penalty
  place: step
  params: {table: table, index: signature, penalty: {int: [1, 127]}}
  means: >
    Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is absent, sets it to the
    table's maximum. If present, adds the penalty to the entry, clamping the
    result to the table's maximum.

- name: confident_bypass
  place: condition
  params: {rdp: table, conf: table, index: signature, rdp_thresh: {int: [0, 127]}, conf_thresh: {int: [0, 3]}}
  means: >
    Reads the entry of the rdp table at the index. If it is absent, returns false.
    Otherwise, reads the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent
    entry as 0). Returns true if the rdp entry is greater than rdp_thresh and the
    conf entry is greater than or equal to conf_thresh.

- name: train_ema
  place: step
  params: {table: table, index: signature, sample: state, scale: {int: [1, 4]}, shift: {int: [0, 7]}}
  means: >
    Calculates a target value as the sample multiplied by the scale, clamped to
    the table's maximum. Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is
    absent, sets it to the target value. If present, computes the signed difference
    (target - entry), divides it by 2 to the power of shift (integer division
    rounding towards zero), and adds the result to the entry. The final value is
    clamped to the table's minimum (0) and maximum.

- name: train_penalty
  place: step
  params: {table: table, index: signature, penalty: {int: [1, 127]}}
  means: >
    Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is absent, sets it to the
    table's maximum. If present, adds the penalty to the entry, clamping the
    result to the table's maximum.

- name: confident_bypass
  place: condition
  params: {rdp: table, conf: table, index: signature, rdp_thresh: {int: [0, 127]}, conf_thresh: {int: [0, 3]}}
  means: >
    Reads the entry of the rdp table at the index. If it is absent, returns false.
    Otherwise, reads the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent
    entry as 0). Returns true if the rdp entry is greater than rdp_thresh and the
    conf entry is greater than or equal to conf_thresh.

- name: train_ema
  place: step
  params: {table: table, index: signature, sample: state, scale: {int: [1, 4]}, shift: {int: [0, 7]}}
  means: >
    Calculates a target value as the sample multiplied by the scale, clamped to
    the table's maximum. Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is
    absent, sets it to the target value. If present, computes the signed difference
    (target - entry), divides it by 2 to the power of shift (integer division
    rounding towards zero), and adds the result to the entry. The final value is
    clamped to the table's minimum (0) and maximum.

- name: train_penalty
  place: step
  params: {table: table, index: signature, penalty: {int: [1, 127]}}
  means: >
    Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is absent, sets it to the
    table's maximum. If present, adds the penalty to the entry, clamping the
    result to the table's maximum.

  place: condition
  params:

    index: signature
    rdp: table

  means: >
    Reads the entry of the rdp table at the index. If it is absent, returns false.
    Otherwise, reads the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent
    entry as 0). Returns true if the rdp entry is greater than rdp_thresh and the
    conf entry is greater than or equal to conf_thresh.

- name: confident_table_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    conf: table
    conf_thresh: {int: [0, 3]}
    div: {int: [1, 15]}
    index: signature
    table: table
  means: >
    Only valid inside victim.bypass_when. Reads the entry of the table at the
    index. If it is absent, returns false. Divides the entry by div (integer
    division rounding down). If the result is less than or equal to the absolute
    value of the victim key of the way the victim search chose, returns false.
    Otherwise, reads the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent
    entry as 0). Returns true if the conf entry is greater than or equal to
    conf_thresh.

    the table's maximum. Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is
    absent, sets it to the target value. If present, computes the signed difference
    (target - entry), divides it by 2 to the power of shift (integer division
    rounding towards zero), and adds the result to the entry. The final value is
    clamped to the table's minimum (0) and maximum.

    table's maximum. If present, adds the penalty to the entry, clamping the
    result to the table's maximum.

    index: signature
    penalty: {int: [1, 127]}
    sample: state
    table: table

    Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is present, greater than

    subtracts the penalty from the entry, clamping the result to 0. Otherwise,
    does nothing.

- name: confident_bypass
  place: condition
  params:
    conf: table
    conf_thresh: {int: [0, 3]}
    index: signature
    rdp: table
    rdp_thresh: {int: [0, 127]}
  means: >
    Reads the entry of the rdp table at the index. If it is absent, returns false. Otherwise, reads
    the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent entry as 0). Returns true if the rdp
    entry is greater than rdp_thresh and the conf entry is greater than or equal to conf_thresh.

- name: train_ema
  place: step
  params:
    index: signature
    sample: state
    scale: {int: [1, 4]}
    shift: {int: [0, 7]}
    table: table
  means: >
    Calculates a target value as the sample multiplied by the scale, clamped to the table's maximum.
    Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is absent, sets it to the target value. If present,
    computes the signed difference (target - entry), divides it by 2 to the power of shift (integer division
    rounding towards zero), and adds the result to the entry. The final value is clamped to the table's
    minimum (0) and maximum.

- name: train_penalty
  place: step
  params:
    index: signature
    penalty: {int: [1, 127]}
    table: table
  means: >
    Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is absent, sets it to the table's maximum. If
    present, adds the penalty to the entry, clamping the result to the table's maximum.

If present, computes the signed difference (target - entry), divides it by 2 to the power of shift (integer division rounding towards zero), and adds the result to the entry. The final value is clamped to the table's minimum (0) and maximum.
